story.title: A clear control room for serious work.
story.description: Every screen maps to an API contract, a permission, and a repeatable Coding Agent workflow.

form.title: Sign in to Aginex
form.description: Use the administrator created during setup.

database.productionHint: The current production distribution requires PostgreSQL. SQLite and MySQL remain available for development, tests, and derived applications.
database.directoryHint: Use a directory writable by the backend process. Relative directories resolve from that process's working directory.
database.filenameHint: Enter one file name without directory separators, for example aginex.db.
database.serverHint: Aginex validates these fields and builds the database configuration on the server.
database.verificationFallback: Aginex could not verify this database.
database.connectionVerifiedDescription: These exact database settings can continue.

heading.caption: Initial authority
